_comment: Audit item #27 CI security scanning. Each entry documents a pip-audit finding with no available fix, reviewed and accepted with a dated reason. Every other finding fails the gate.

allowed.reason: Rechecked GHSA-8mgp-746c-j5xp and fresh pip-audit on 2026-10-03: nltk 3.10.3 still has no upstream fix. Affected APIs: TransitionParser.train/parse, AveragedPerceptron.save/load, PerceptronTagger.save_to_json and save_maxent_params. No civiccast/ or tests/ code imports nltk or calls those APIs. The lock's sole nltk parent is optional crawl4ai 0.9.2. Its installed source uses tokenization/corpus helpers, not these model-file APIs; CivicCast's js_portal adapter supplies CrawlerRunConfig(cache_mode=BYPASS), whose defaults are RegexChunking and no extraction strategy. No caller-controlled model path reaches the affected APIs through the current adapter. NLTK is absent from requirements-native-app.txt. This is scoped source reachability evidence, not an exploitation test or a claim that NLTK is secure. Re-review by 2026-11-03 or on caller/dependency changes, and upgrade when fixed. Old PYSEC-2026-597 exemption removed because it is absent from the current exact-version scan.
